title: Spanish Lentil Paella
description: A twist on the classic Spanish dish, incorporating lentils for added protein and nutrition. This recipe serves 4-6 people.

ingredients.name: Lentils
ingredients.notes: Green or brown lentils work well

ingredients.name: Paella Spices
ingredients.notes: Use a mix of paprika, saffron, and thyme

instructions: Heat the fermented olive oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the paella spices and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the lentils and cook for 2-3 minutes, until they begin to brown.
Add the Spanish rice and cook for 2-3 minutes, until it begins to brown.
Add the zesty tomato paste and stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, until the rice and lentils are cooked.
Fluff the paella with a fork and garnish with fresh parsley.
